scenes.text: This is what centella actually does to irritated skin.
scenes.head:
What centella
does to red skin

scenes.text: When your skin is irritated, inflammation builds up under the surface. That's the redness, and the sting.
scenes.head:
Step 1
Irritation builds

scenes.text: Centella, also called cica, helps calm that inflammation down.
scenes.head:
Step 2
Centella calms it

scenes.text: It also supports your skin barrier, so it can repair itself.
scenes.head:
Step 3
The barrier repairs

scenes.text: On the label, look for madecassoside. Next episode: hyaluronic acid.

caption:
What centella actually does to irritated skin 🌿
Irritation builds inflammation under the surface. Centella (cica) helps calm it and supports your barrier while it repairs.
On the label: centella asiatica, madecassoside, asiaticoside.
Send this to someone with sensitive skin. Ingredient Explained, ep. 02.
